package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

// lockStudentAdmissionFence is the single Student-owned serialization point for
// a student's onboarding readiness and learning-path admission state.  Every
// writer that can change either side takes this lock before inspecting rows.
func lockStudentAdmissionFence(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, studentID string) error {
	_, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1, 0))`, "learning-path:"+studentID)
	return err
}

// hasLiveOnboardingPathAdmission is deliberately schema-aware rather than
// controlled by an optional repository boolean.  This preserves pre-025
// deployments while making every constructed repository fail closed whenever
// durable admission evidence exists (including after the HTTP feature flag is
// turned off to drain traffic).
func hasLiveOnboardingPathAdmission(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, studentID string) (bool, error) {
	var installed bool
	if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass('public.student_onboarding_path_admission') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&installed); err != nil || !installed {
		return false, err
	}
	var live bool
	err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM student_onboarding_path_admission
WHERE student_id=$1 AND status='RESERVED' AND expires_at>now())`, studentID).Scan(&live)
	return live, err
}
